tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked hypoxemia (O2 saturation 78%) and significantly elevated NT-proBNP, suggesting possible acute or chronic heart failure. Mild anemia is present (low erythrocytes, normal Hb), and HbA1c is elevated, indicating suboptimal glycemic control. Chloride is slightly high, but renal and liver function are within normal limits. No acute myocardial injury is detected (normal troponin). Recommend urgent clinical assessment for hypoxemia and heart failure management.
